correctness.rationale: Circle-length-m coding gives exactly mn distinct n-word intervals. Established Kesten criterion is converted to an integer-part modular test on neighboring cuts. An independently proved 3-case successor map gives multiplicities n-a, n-b, a+b-n. Fibonacci convergent indices plus parity of F_j prove three exact phase formulas. A standalone independent cut-sort checker passed 3840 formula and 640 successor checks and 13 golden identities; finite tests do not establish infinite claims.

value.rationale: For a natural finite-to-one extension of an irrational rotation, this is a complete and effective all-length classification of which cylinder frequencies have uniformly bounded discrepancy. The exact Fibonacci phase law exhibits both arbitrarily long lengths with no bounded-remainder cylinders and other lengths with asymptotically positive fractions; strict ergodicity itself does not imply this.
